name: – Anna Strolenberg – After § 40 – Am 64
title: REPORT on the situation of fundamental rights in the European Union in 2024 and 2025
part_text: 40b. Underlines that freedom of expression, as a cornerstone of democracy protected by Article 11 of the Charter, must not be unduly restricted by excessive enforcement of the Digital Services Act or platforms’ content moderation policies that risk repressing legitimate political debate;
